# Quick Start: Conformal Regression

Wrap any scikit-learn model with **statistically rigorous coverage guarantees** using `ConformalRegressor`.

This notebook demonstrates the core workflow:

1. Load tabular data (concrete compressive strength)
2. Wrap a GradientBoostingRegressor with conformal prediction
3. Extract intervals, quantiles, and samples from predictions
4. Evaluate calibration

## Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup
#| cache: true
import polars as pl
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge

from uncertainty_flow.metrics import coverage_score, winkler_score
from uncertainty_flow.utils.split import select_validation_plan
from uncertainty_flow.wrappers import ConformalRegressor
```

## Configuration

```{python}
#| label: config
target_col = "strength"
base_model_choice = "GradientBoosting"
coverage_target = 0.9
```

## Load Data

```{python}
#| label: load-data
#| cache: true
df = pl.read_parquet("../data/concrete.parquet")
print(f"Dataset shape: {df.shape}")
df.head(10)
```

## Train / Test Split

```{python}
#| label: split
#| cache: true
plan = select_validation_plan(df, task_type="tabular", random_state=42)
train_df, test_df = plan.outer_split
actuals = test_df[target_col]
print(f"Strategy: {plan.metadata.strategy_name} | Train: {len(train_df)} | Test: {len(test_df)}")
```

## Train Conformal Model

```{python}
#| label: train
#| cache: true
base_cls = GradientBoostingRegressor if base_model_choice == "GradientBoosting" else Ridge
base = base_cls(random_state=42)

model = ConformalRegressor(
    base_model=base,
    coverage_target=coverage_target,
    auto_tune=True,
    random_state=42,
)
model.fit(train_df, target=target_col)
print(model)
```

## Predict

```{python}
#| label: predict
#| cache: true
pred = model.predict(test_df)
print(pred)
```

## Intervals

```{python}
#| label: intervals
interval_df = pred.interval(confidence=coverage_target)
print(interval_df.head(10))
```

## Quantiles

```{python}
#| label: quantiles
quantiles_df = pred.quantile([0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95])
print(quantiles_df.head(10))
```

## Mean

```{python}
#| label: mean
mean_series = pred.mean()
print(mean_series.head(10))
```

## Evaluate Coverage

```{python}
#| label: evaluate
interval = pred.interval(confidence=coverage_target)
coverage = coverage_score(actuals, interval["lower"], interval["upper"])
winkler = winkler_score(
    actuals, interval["lower"], interval["upper"], confidence=coverage_target
)
print(f"Coverage: {coverage:.3f} | Winkler score: {winkler:.2f}")
```

## Prediction Plot

```{python}
#| label: plot
fig = pred.plot(
    actuals=actuals,
    confidence_bands=[0.5, 0.8, coverage_target],
    title=f"Conformal Prediction — {target_col}",
)
fig
```

## Calibration Report

```{python}
#| label: calibration
calibration = model.calibration_report(test_df, target_col)
print(calibration)
```

## Uncertainty Drivers

```{python}
#| label: drivers
drivers = model.uncertainty_drivers_
print(drivers)
```
